title: Why he took the job and Zutty's playing
summary: Roy explains he took the job after Zutty talked him into it, and Zutty played well on Louis's tunes.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, he probably always secretly wanted to be the leader.
Well, he talked me into taking that job. I didn't want that job really. And to show you what, I used to bring Scotch down for him, because Zutty was supposed to sing the Blues.

That's why I took the job. I used to bring Scotch down there, so he'd have Scotch (?) downstairs, you know. The job was pleasant, you know. The job wasn't paying that much, though. So I don't know. Shit, I tried my best. He could be somethin' else.
When we were in Chicago, we were playing some of things
of Louis', man, he was really groovin' then, you know. When he wanted to play those things, he could play it. Like "Chinatown," man. People loved that, you know.
He plays well on those records.
